cues.text: Let's add a new staff member.
Open HR and Staff, then Staff Directory. It lists everyone who works at the school.
Press Full Form to open the complete staff form.
Enter the first and last name, then the email and phone number.
Choose the department and the designation. Both are optional, but they make reports and payroll easier.
Press Add Staff Member. A login account is optional and can be added later. The new staff member appears in the directory.
